symptom: lint, report and search hung forever (31 minutes once) at 'building catalog, source 2183/2184 documents' with 0% CPU, on a project with an existing source-mode .mxcli/catalog.db; deleting the file made the build finish in 22 s.
cause: Not identified: the progress line kept ticking, so runDescribes never returned — one describe blocked (0% CPU: a wait, not a loop). 2183 of 2184 to describe means nothing was reused, i.e. the incremental attempt fell back to a full rebuild inside the same process. Not reproduced on a small project; the reporter offers the stale file.
fix: runDescribes gives up on a describe after describeStallAfter (2m): it is recorded as a failure naming the wait, a replacement worker keeps the queue running, the build finishes, and every goroutine's stack goes to the session log so the next occurrence names the blocked wait.
insight: A worker pool that waits on wg.Wait with no deadline turns one blocked call into a hang of every gate that refreshes the catalog. When the root cause needs data you do not have, bound the wait and dump the stacks at the moment it trips: the next report then carries the diagnosis. The 'N-1/N' line comes from the ticker, so it proves the describes had not returned.
test: mdl/catalog/builder_source_test.go TestRunDescribes_StalledDescribeIsGivenUpOn_2641 (one worker, stuck first: still finishes, the rest run, the stall is reported); with the window set to an hour it times out as the hang did. -race clean.
